name: Youth Volunteer Program (ages 13+)
what_you_do: You greet guests. You also help COSI educators as an operational volunteer. First you apply and do an interview. Then you finish three weekend training sessions.
who_can_apply: New applicants must be in grades 7 to 11 and at least 13. Accepted volunteers must attend three weekend training sessions.
duration: Three weekend trainings (Feb to Apr 2027), then ongoing volunteering; hours not stated
deadline_text: Applications open Dec 1, 2026 and close Dec 15, 2026. Interviews Jan 6, 7 or 9, decisions Jan 15, trainings Feb 6/7, Mar 6/7 and Apr 17/18.
how_to_apply: Online youth volunteer application during the December window, then an in-person interview at COSI.
notes: Candidates who cannot attend all three trainings are told to reapply later. COSI also lists one-day Quick Impact volunteer shifts; check each listing for its age rule.
